targetTexts.1: Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.
targetTexts.2: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wonders.
targetTexts.3: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
targetTexts.4: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
targetTexts.5: Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,
targetTexts.6: O offspring of His servant Abraham, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
targetTexts.7: He is the LORD our God; His judgments carry throughout the earth.
targetTexts.8: He remembers His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations—
targetTexts.9: the covenant He made with Abraham, and the oath He swore to Isaac.
targetTexts.10: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:
targetTexts.11: “I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance.”
targetTexts.12: When they were few in number, few indeed, and strangers in the land,
targetTexts.13: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
targetTexts.14: He let no man oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf:
targetTexts.15: “Do not touch My anointed ones! Do no harm to My prophets!”
targetTexts.16: He called down famine on the land and cut off all their supplies of food.
targetTexts.17: He sent a man before them—Joseph, sold as a slave.
targetTexts.18: They bruised his feet with shackles and placed his neck in irons,
targetTexts.19: until his prediction came true and the word of the LORD proved him right.
targetTexts.20: The king sent and released him; the ruler of peoples set him free.
targetTexts.21: He made him master of his household, ruler over all his substance,
targetTexts.22: to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.
targetTexts.23: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob dwelt in the land of Ham.
targetTexts.24: And the LORD made His people very fruitful, more numerous than their foes,
targetTexts.25: whose hearts He turned to hate His people, to conspire against His servants.
targetTexts.26: He sent Moses His servant, and Aaron, whom He had chosen.
targetTexts.27: They performed His miraculous signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
targetTexts.28: He sent darkness, and it became dark—yet they defied His words.
targetTexts.29: He turned their waters to blood and caused their fish to die.
targetTexts.30: Their land teemed with frogs, even in their royal chambers.
targetTexts.31: He spoke, and insects swarmed—gnats throughout their country.
targetTexts.32: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning throughout their land.
targetTexts.33: He struck their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.
targetTexts.34: He spoke, and the locusts came—young locusts without number.
targetTexts.35: They devoured every plant in their land and consumed the produce of their soil.
targetTexts.36: Then He struck all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their vigor.
targetTexts.37: He brought Israel out with silver and gold, and none among His tribes stumbled.
targetTexts.38: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the dread of Israel had fallen on them.
targetTexts.39: He spread a cloud as a covering and a fire to light up the night.
targetTexts.40: They asked, and He brought quail and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
targetTexts.41: He opened a rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.
targetTexts.42: For He remembered His holy promise to Abraham His servant.
targetTexts.43: He brought forth His people with rejoicing, His chosen with shouts of joy.
targetTexts.44: He gave them the lands of the nations, that they might inherit the fruit of others’ labor,
targetTexts.45: that they might keep His statutes and obey His laws. Hallelujah!
